facts.text: Gina expressed appreciation for Jon's studio and emphasized the importance of having a creative space for dancers.

evidence.quote: But really having a creative space for dancers is so important. Last Friday at dance class with a group of friends I felt it. Your studio will be a go-to spot for self-expression.

facts.text: Jon acknowledged Gina's encouragement and expressed excitement about his studio welcoming dancers of all ages and backgrounds.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Gina! Your words of encouragement keep me motivated. Can't wait 'til my studio starts welcoming dancers of all ages and backgrounds!

facts.text: Gina affirmed that her words were motivating Jon and expressed happiness about his progress.

evidence.quote: I'm so happy to see my words motivating you, Jon. <3

facts.text: Jon thanked Gina for her help and encouragement, stating that her support would help him make his dream a reality.

evidence.quote: Thanks a ton, Gina! Your help and encouragement mean a lot. Your support will help me make it happen.
